subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should maintainers solve this Telegram SOCKS5 stall through a shared scheme-aware proxy fix now, or defer until stronger live proof narrows the proxy/DNS/fallback contract?
rationale: The source and Undici contract make a real proxy transport gap plausible, but the repair direction affects shared proxy behavior and the current candidate PR is incomplete and unproven.

options.title: Adopt Shared Proxy Fix
options.body: Review or replace the open proxy PR with explicit/env SOCKS, HTTP, and HTTPS coverage plus live Telegram SOCKS proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait For Live Reproduction
options.body: Keep this issue open as needs-live-repro until a current-release service-context run proves the exact SOCKS5 stall path.

options.title: Route To IPv4 Policy Work
options.body: Treat this as part of the force-IPv4/DNS policy discussion if maintainers decide the proxy evidence is secondary to broken address-family selection.

recommendation.title: Adopt Shared Proxy Fix
recommendation.body: Review or replace the open proxy PR with explicit/env SOCKS, HTTP, and HTTPS coverage plus live Telegram SOCKS proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest Telegram subsystem routing candidate and have history in the implicated fallback-chain surface.
